# HEARD Alliance

> > HEARD Alliance connects families, schools, and clinicians across the Bay Area with comprehensive youth mental health promotion, crisis intervention, and suicide prevention resources.

HEARD Alliance is a collaborative Bay Area organization dedicated to improving youth mental health and suicide prevention through evidence-based resources, training, and community partnerships. The platform serves three primary audiences—youth and families, schools, and clinicians—with tailored support for mental health promotion, crisis intervention, and post-crisis recovery.

## Key Topics

- Suicide Prevention
- Youth Mental Health
- Crisis Intervention
- Crisis Support
- Mental Health Promotion
- School Mental Health
- Clinician Resources
- Youth Wellbeing
- Grief Support
- Community Support
- Mental Health Toolkit
- Student Wellbeing
- Evidence-Based Interventions
- Post-Crisis Postvention
- K-12 Mental Health

## Core Resources for Youth & Families

- [Youth & Families | Start Here](https://www.heardalliance.org/youth-families): Entry point for youth & families accessing mental health resources & support
- [Mental Health Resources for Families](https://www.heardalliance.org/youth-families/families): Family resources for supporting children's mental health & navigating challenges
- [Youth Mental Health Support](https://www.heardalliance.org/youth-families/youth): Youth-focused resources on mental health, resilience & coping strategies
- [Youth Crisis Support & Suicide Prevention Resources](https://www.heardalliance.org/heard-hub-post/crisis-support-resources): Crisis support resources with hotlines & 24/7 services for youth mental health
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://www.heardalliance.org/youth-families/frequently-asked-questions): FAQs on youth mental health, warning signs & crisis support resources

## School Mental Health Programs

- [Schools | Start Here](https://www.heardalliance.org/schools): School-focused entry point for mental health collaboration & student support programs
- [Mental Health Promotion in Schools](https://www.heardalliance.org/schools/mental-health-promotion): Proactive strategies & programs for student mental well-being in schools
- [Intervention Strategies for Schools](https://www.heardalliance.org/schools/crisis-intervention): Crisis intervention protocols & early identification resources for schools
- [Postvention Resources for Schools](https://www.heardalliance.org/schools/postvention): Post-crisis guidance for schools after student suicide or mental health emergency
- [School Mental Health Needs Assessment](https://www.heardalliance.org/schools/needs-assessment-form): Assessment tool for evaluating school mental health support systems

## Clinician Resources & Training

- [Clinicians | Start Here](https://www.heardalliance.org/clinicians): Clinician-focused entry point for mental health & suicide prevention resources
- [Mental Health Promotion for Clinicians](https://www.heardalliance.org/clinicians/promotion): Clinician tools & strategies for proactive youth mental well-being promotion
- [Intervention Resources for Clinicians](https://www.heardalliance.org/clinicians/intervention): Evidence-based intervention protocols & screening tools for clinicians
- [Postvention Support for Clinicians](https://www.heardalliance.org/clinicians/postvention-resources): Clinician guidance for post-crisis support & community healing after suicide
